## Où j'en suis
Prepared the PostgreSQL 17 upgrade for the analytics RDS on branch noa/rds-pg17: parameter group family derived from engine version, blue/green enabled on staging (16.4 → 17.2), prod prepared but disabled behind `pg17_enabled = false`. Plans are clean (staging: 1 add, 1 change; prod: no changes) and nothing was applied. Draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 opened with the pg_partman and dbt-lock caveats in the description.

- [en-cours] Staging upgrade is planned but not applied; blocked by pg_partman upgrade first
- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 on staging 16.4, then check `run_maintenance_proc()` on events_raw/events_daily
- [prochaine-étape] Pick a production window avoiding the dbt lock (01:00–03:30 UTC), pending Maya's sign-off
- [essai-raté] AWS provider v6.4.0 pulled in unrelated changes (S3 ACL, EIP); user ordered a pin to ~>5.82.0
- [essai-raté] Proposed prod cutover Sat 28 Nov 02:00 UTC with `apply_immediately = true`; rejected — falls inside the dbt lock, date needs Maya's sign-off, flag reverted to false
- [décision] Pin AWS provider to ~>5.82.0, no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] Plan only, never apply anything (source: t01)
- [décision] No prod date or changes until Maya signs off; `apply_immediately` stays false (source: t14)
